item.title: Translating sulfur flow batteries into deployable systems
item.description:
این مقاله راهکارهای تبدیل باتری‌های جریان سولفور از مرحله آزمایشگاهی به سیستم‌های قابل استقرار و مقیاس‌پذیر را بررسی می‌کند.
Nature Energy | ⭐ Review
💡 The novelty lies in reframing sulfur flow battery research around deployment rather than material cost alone, revealing how real-world translation exposes scientific and engineering bottlenecks. Its significance is guiding research priorities toward practical viability, helping convert a promising low-cost, long-duration storage concept into deployable systems.

item.title: Structure-Dynamics Correlations in Ionic Liquid-Based Solid Electrolytes Explored by NMR Spectroscopy
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using NMR spectroscopy to correlate structure and dynamics in ionic-liquid-based solid electrolytes, revealing how molecular organization governs ion transport. Its significance is providing mechanistic insight into designing mechanically stable polymer electrolytes with favorable conductivity, advancing safer, high-performance solid-state battery development.
